name: W. B. Milne
role: Minneapolis dry-goods salesman (Wyman, Mullin & Van Dyke)
bio: W. B. Milne was a travelling salesman for the Minneapolis dry-goods house of Wyman, Mullin & Van Dyke who made periodic visits to Medora from March 1884. By January 1885 the paper said he was doing a good business in Medora for his house and called him one of the most popular travelling men on the road.

moments.label: Praised as a popular travelling salesman
